name: Preparing for Success Pathway Scholarship (SCU)
summary: $2,500 offered with an Early Offer to SCU's Preparing for Success pathway program in 2027, paid as you progress into a bachelor degree.
key: Each scholarship is worth a total of $2,500.
who: Starting the Preparing for Success program in 2027 with an Early Offer.
Completing it in 2027 and moving straight into the packaged bachelor degree.
how: No separate application. It comes with the course offer.
catches: 60 places, given to the first 60 students who accept, with a waiting list.
Paid in instalments: $250 per completed unit (up to $1,000), $500 after census, $1,000 after the first two bachelor subjects.
